answer: Require each new identity to prove a distinct physical location before it can trade: independent beacons attest its presence, and at most two identities may share one 1 km cell per epoch. A haven that hosts dozens of identities in one cell is capped, and an island of beacons that all attest the same cluster is flagged. To forge another identity, an attacker must place a real device or bribe a new beacon in a new cell for every fake, so cost grows with each added identity, while a failed beacon check revokes the whole cell batch.
